metadata.case_name: CHAN NGA YIN FORMERLY KNOWN AS CHAN MEI YI SICELY v. MTR CORPORATION LTD

source: She suffered left wrist injury as a result.
There was fracture of left distal radius confirmed by radiographs.
X-ray taken in March 2013 showed healed fracture left distal radius with implant in-situ.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: Could not lift heavy objects / difficulty lifting heavy objects
Pain more intense when the weather changed or when attempting to lift heavy objects
Mild limitation of range of movement of left wrist
Pain on movement and upon exertion
Reduced left hand grip (left hand grip 20 kg vs right 28 kg)

treatments_received.treatment: Open reduction and internal fixation with metallic implant in situ
source: Open reduction and internal fixation with metallic implant in situ were performed under general anaesthesia.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (5 sessions between 20 January and 24 February 2011)
source: She received 5 sessions of physiotherapy treatment between 20 January and 24 February 2011.
Physiotherapy of ultrasound, wax therapy, wrist mobilization and strengthening exercises were given to her for improving mobility and muscle strength.

treatments_future.treatment: Physiotherapy (claimed 24 sessions / Dr Chak recommended physiotherapy for strengthening exercise for 3 months, two sessions per week, total around $12,000)
source: The plaintiff claims $12,000 under the head of further medical expenses for 24 physiotherapy sessions as recommended by Dr Chak.
Dr Chak opined that she might need to have physiotherapy for strengthening exercise for 3 months. Two sessions per week and each session might cost $500. The total expenses would be around $12,000.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: She had difficulty performing household chores.
She changed her job to become a cashier because her previous duties included lifting heavy objects and she felt left wrist pain.
